audience: sales and account teams that keep their customer records in Koban CRM

useCases.title: Find an account and its deals
useCases.text: Search the accounts by label, then list the deals linked to the account you pick.

useCases.title: Review the leads in one status
useCases.text: List the leads that have a status code such as MQL. Open one lead to see its person, company and tags.

useCases.title: Find a contact by e-mail address
useCases.text: Find the contacts that use an e-mail address, with their accounts. Open one contact to read its phone number and function.

useCases.title: Sync records changed since a date
useCases.text: List the accounts, contacts or deals changed after a Unix time, one page at a time, to update another system.

useCases.title: Review the open actions of a user
useCases.text: List the open actions of one user, optionally in a date range. Open one action to read its details.

useCases.title: Save an account and log a follow-up call
useCases.text: Create or update an account by its external code, then add a follow-up call. Each action call creates a new action, so a retry adds a duplicate.
